sections.section_title: Contextual Background: GLP-1 Receptor Agonists, Metabolic Disease, and Immune-Mediated Myopa-thy
sections.description: This section establishes the essential medical knowledge required to understand the case, specifically focusing on the mechanism of action of GLP-1 receptor agonists, their safety profile regarding muscle mass, and the distinctions between statin-associated myopathy and other autoimmune myopathic presentations. It frames the unique Challenge of identifying a non-statins trigger for IMNM.

Role of HMGCR and SRP Autoantibodies in IMNM

sections.section_title: Clinical Presentation and Timeline: Unmasking the Revascularization Defect
sections.description: This section details the narrative flow of the patient's illness, from baseline comorbidities to the triggering event and subsequent evolution of symptoms. It teaches students to identify temporal cues that separate drug-reaction-related illness from pre-existing conditions, highlighting the critical window between the initial hospitalization and the muscle weakness.
subtopics: Baseline Medical History: Obesity, NAFLD, and Hypothyroidism Context

sections.section_title: Diagnostic Reasoning: Integrating Histology, Serology, and Differential Diagnosis
sections.description: This section focuses on the critical diagnostic steps taken by the clinical team to differentiate drug-induced toxin from autoimmune pathology. It guides learners through interpreting the biopsy (necrosis vs. lymphocytic infiltrate), the significance of negative serology in IMNM diagnosis, and how to rule out alternatives like stress-induced myopathy or stress cardiomyopathy.
subtopics: Muscle Biopsy Interpretation: Necrotizing Fibers and Myophagocytosis
Histologic Hallmarks of IMNM: Low Lymphocytic Infiltrate
Autoantibody Panel Correlation: Implications of Seronegative Status

Exclusion of Red Flags: Myocardium, Lung, and Other Autoimmune Diseases
The Significance of Predisposing Factors (Serology discrepancy)

sections.section_title: Management Strategies: Pharmacological Intervention for Immune Myositis
sections.description: This section outlines the specific therapeutic algorithm used in this case, including the rationale for pulse steroids versus IVIG, and the criteria for tapering immunosuppression. It teaches the medical student how to manage IMNM when the offending agent has been removed but the immunologic response persists, emphasizing the balance between efficacy and toxicity.
subtopics: First-Line Therapy: High-Dose Pulse Methylprednisolone for Acute Abrupt Severity
Adjuvant Therapy: Rationale for Intravenous Immunoglobulin (IVIG) in Resistant Cases

Monitoring Response: Decline in CK as a Clinical Marker of Recovery

Risk Assessment for Irreversible Damage: Cardiac and Skeletal Muscle

sections.section_title: Outcomes, Long-Term Follow-Up, and Clinical Governance
sections.description: This section concludes the textbook chapter by summarizing the recovery trajectory and the broader clinical significance of the case. It reinforces lessons on pharmacovigilance, causality assessment (UMC criteria), and the potential for long-term seronegative sequelae, providing a template for future case awareness.
